input.summary: Tungabhadra Actives LLP (V02), contact Anand. Sent quotation and COA (Niacinamide) for RFx KPC-2026-014, footnote included (not reviewed here). Open: RM-001 quoted per drum with no net weight, so kg conversion impossible; MOQ 2 drum not convertible to kg. RM-003 COA dated 2026-03-10 is over 6 months old. Knockouts Q5 (COA per line), Q9 (SDS + leave-on suitability), Q10 (2-8 C cold chain) unanswered. Q8 (manufacturer/trader) open. Response deadline 14 Nov 2026. No commitments made.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014 - Quotation follow-up and information needed
input.body:
Dear Anand,

Thank you for your quotation and the Niacinamide COA. We need the following to complete our evaluation:

RM-001 Propanediol (bio-based)
1. The net weight per drum in kg.
2. The MOQ expressed in kg (your quote states 2 drums).

RM-003 Niacinamide (PC grade)
3. A current COA. The one dated 10 March 2026 is more than 6 months old. Please send a COA from a recent batch showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.

Questionnaire (mandatory)
4. Certificates of Analysis from a recent batch for each line in your quote, showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.
5. The Safety Data Sheet for each material, and confirmation that each is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.
6. Can you deliver with an unbroken 2-8 C cold chain? Please describe your packaging and temperature logging.
7. Are you the manufacturer or a trader? Please name the manufacturer and site, any second source, and whether you will share delivery and rejection records.

Please reply by 14 November 2026. Items 1 to 3 are needed to convert your quote to kg for comparison.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
